body.input: Which energy companies opened an office in Norway in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, I was unable to find a comprehensive list of all energy companies that opened an office in Norway specifically in 2026. The search results surfaced a few relevant examples, but none with confirmed 2026 dates for office openings:

- **Hexagon Purus Maritime** opened new offices in **Ålesund, Norway**, comprising 450 square metres of office space plus a 150 square metre workshop, to support its growing hydrogen fuel systems business for maritime vessels. The announcement appeared in 2026-era industry coverage.

- **WEG Scandinavia** (a subsidiary of Brazilian industrial equipment maker WEG) announced the opening of a new sales office in **Bergen, Norway**, to serve the Norwegian industrial sector — particularly oil and gas and sustainability-related segments.

Several other results referenced energy-sector office openings in Norway from earlier years (e.g., Claxton in Stavanger, Workstrings International in Stavanger, Edgen Murray in Sandnes), but these were not confirmed as 2026 events.

If you are looking for a more exhaustive list, industry databases such as the Norwegian business register (Brønnøysundregistrene) or trade organizations like Offshore Norge may have more detailed records of new energy-sector establishments in Norway during 2026.

WEG Scandinavia announced the opening of a new sales office in Bergen, Norway, expanding its presence in the Norwegian industrial and energy sector, as described in the second fact.

Title: WEG Scandinavia Expands Operations with New Office in Norway - MVPro Media
# WEG Scandinavia Expands Operations with New Office in Norway. **WEG** **has announced a further expansion in Scandinavia with the opening of a new office in Bergen, Norway.**. As part of the existing WEG Scandinavia branch, the Norway office will establish a greater presence in the region, aligning with WEG’s vision for long-term growth and development in Scandinavia. With the new sales office located in central Bergen, WEG intends to provide comprehensive support and tailored industrial equipment solutions to Norwegian customers. With a focus on promoting, selling and providing a diverse range of products including motors, variable frequency inverters (VFDs), generators and gear motors, WEG’s investment in the new office aims to fulfil the evolving needs of the Norwegian industrial sector. *“We see great potential in the Norwegian market, particularly in segments such as the oil and gas industry,”* says Anders Näzell, managing director at WEG Scandinavia. *“As Norway increasingly focuses on meeting its national sustainability targets, there will be a need for the country to transition away from its traditional dependence on the oil and gas industry and decarbonise these operations.”*. *“As part of our commitment to sustainability, we want to establish a strong foothold in Norway to support the country in its transition. At the new facility, business development managers will oversee operations in Norway. *“We are dedicated to strengthening partnerships and collaborations with local companies to drive innovation and value for our customers,”* added Näzell. The expansion demonstrates WEG’s commitment to making substantial investments in Norway to ensure that it can provide comprehensive support and deliver more cost-effective, environmentally friendly and efficient technical solutions to the market. Looking ahead, WEG anticipates further expansion and potential recruitment of technical sales engineers to support its growing operations. 1.
